chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey: Teleportation Escape & The End of an Era
chapter_meta_description: Han Li completes the ancient formation, triggering a desperate escape from the Ghost Spirit Sect. A world-changing teleportation and a glimpse of Tian Nan’s bloody future.
og_title: Teleportation into the Unknown: Han Li’s Great Escape
og_description: The ancient formation is complete! Han Li faces the Ghost Spirit Sect in a final showdown and vanishes into the unknown, leaving Tian Nan behind forever.
twitter_title: Han Li pulls off the ultimate escape—teleporting into the unknown and leaving his enemies in the dust!
twitter_description: The climax of the Tian Nan arc! Han Li completes an ancient teleportation formation, fights off a demonic siege, and flees into a new, dangerous world.

lore_anchors.definition: A critical artifact needed to safely navigate spatial travel through ancient formations; its rarity and value are immense.
A prehistoric magical array capable of crossing tens of thousands of miles; their construction knowledge is lost, making them priceless.
The third major realm of cultivation; cultivators can use magic treasures and have dramatically increased power and lifespan.
The name chosen for the multi-nation alliance formed to resist the Demonic Path and Righteous Alliance.
The unique cultivators of the Moulan Tribe, who practice a distinct school of magic called "Spiritual Arts."
An alliance of nine nations formed for mutual protection, a key power block in the ensuing wars.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Han Li have to teleport?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He was cornered by the Ghost Spirit Sect with no escape; using the ancient teleportation was his only remaining option, and its activation exposed his location, forcing an immediate departure.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What happened to the six sects from Yue?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They fled to the Nine Nations Alliance but were quickly drawn into resource wars and battles against the Moulan Dharma Warriors, suffering heavy losses over time.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Did Han Li’s master, Li Huayuan, die?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yes, the chapter's epilogue reveals he died in battle about a decade after Han Li’s teleportation.
